Fact.Description: HDHP minimum annual deductible, family coverage. Rev. Proc. 2025-19 §2.01, p. 2 (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-25-19.pdf): a high deductible health plan is defined "as a health plan with an annual deductible that is not less than $1,700 for self-only coverage or $3,400 for family coverage, and for which the annual out-of-pocket expenses (deductibles, co-payments, and other amounts, but not premiums) do not exceed $8,500 for self-only coverage or $17,000 for family coverage." IRC §223(c)(2) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/223).

The last day that form 5498s can be sent to the TP. #91: TY2026 Form 5498-SA is furnished by May 31, 2027 (Instructions for Forms 1099-SA and 5498-SA, https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i1099sa); May 31, 2027 is Memorial Day (5 U.S.C. 6103(a), https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/5/6103), so under IRC sec. 7503 (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/7503) the date is the next business day, Tuesday June 1, 2027.
